summary: After the menu modal renderer split, the remaining modules large enough to clear roughly 10 KB gzip are mostly first-paint, route, auth/session, public menu, cart/order, or Firebase-sensitive. The safest inspected candidate was the overlay event binder group, but a trial build showed only a 5,588 byte gzip reduction, below the requested threshold. Implementation was reverted and this pass stops after the audit.

recommendedCandidate.reason: No inspected candidate safely reached around 10 KB gzip reduction. The only safe trial candidate, overlay event binders, reduced gzip by 5,588 bytes and was reverted. Larger candidates are route, public menu, cart/order, Firebase, auth/session, or /feed first-paint critical.

riskList: First overlay click before the lazy binder chunk finishes loading could be delayed; mitigation is caching one pending bind request and invoking the existing binders as soon as the chunk resolves.
Public product detail buttons are bound by the same existing menu-detail binder after lazy load; renderers, cart keys, and order payloads are unchanged.
The chunk size may land slightly below 10 KB gzip; if the built entry does not reduce meaningfully, implementation must be reverted.
